clue.text: Tory privilege

definitions.meaning: a Tory belongs to the political ... wing, so the word can stand for that side
an entitlement, as in having the ... to vote

explanation.definitionFit: A Conservative sits on the political right, and an entitlement or prerogative is likewise a right.

clue.text: Payment facility invalidating bad credit

indicators.note: invalidating something unmakes it, so these letters are undone and set out afresh

explanation.surface: A card for paying is cancelled because of the holder's poor credit record.
explanation.walkthrough: 'invalidating' shuffles BAD CREDIT into the answer's letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Paying by card that draws straight from a bank account is a payment method offered by banks.

clue.text: Amusing woman honoured, not disheartened, to see bottom

parts.note: amusing means fun
a Dame is a woman given a British honour, the female equivalent of a knighthood

indicators.note: losing its heart means the middle letter of the word not is taken away

explanation.surface: An entertaining decorated lady, still in good spirits, goes to look at the lowest point.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disheartened' drops the middle O of NOT, leaving NT. 'to see' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Fundament is an old-fashioned, faintly comic word for the buttocks, a person's behind.

clue.text: Animal that's more outrageous, might you say?

indicators.note: asks the solver to voice the word, here with the initial H dropped as in some London accents

parts.note: hot can mean scandalous or outrageous, so more outrageous gives hotter

explanation.surface: A creature described as more shocking, perhaps?
explanation.walkthrough: The homophone relies on dropping the H, as Cockney speakers famously do.
explanation.definitionFit: A river-dwelling mammal with webbed feet is a kind of animal.

clue.text: Guarantee there's condemnation with leadership lacking

indicators.note: lacking its leading letter means the opening C is dropped

parts.note: censure is formal condemnation

explanation.surface: A promise that there will be criticism, though no leaders are around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with leadership lacking' removes the first letter C from CENSURE.
explanation.definitionFit: To guarantee an outcome is to make certain of it, the verb sense here.

clue.text: Following trail associated with European standard bearer

parts.note: F is the standard abbreviation for following, as in page references
to trail is to lag behind
a Pole is a European from Poland

explanation.surface: Coming behind a European banner carrier, perhaps in a procession.
explanation.walkthrough: 'associated with' is a link. A standard is a flag, so 'standard bearer' is not a person here.
explanation.definitionFit: A standard is a flag, and the pole is what holds it aloft, literally bearing it.

clue.text: Vital fuel injected into vessel where parts of the body shaken?

definitions.text: where parts of the body shaken?

indicators.note: something injected goes inside, so these pieces are placed within the vessel word

parts.note: a hoy is a small coastal sailing vessel
key means vital or essential
coke is a fuel made from coal

explanation.surface: Essential fuel pumped into a ship where body parts get jolted around.
explanation.walkthrough: The HOKEY COKEY is a British party dance in which you put your left arm in, out, and shake it about.
explanation.definitionFit: In this group dance participants shake an arm, a leg and so on in turn, hence the cryptic description.

clue.text: Tease backward old writer

indicators.note: backward tells the solver to read the teasing word from right to left

parts.note: to rib someone is to tease them

explanation.surface: Mocking a slow-witted elderly author.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backward' looks like an insult for the writer but turns RIB into BIR.
explanation.definitionFit: A Biro is the British trademark name for a ballpoint pen, something that writes.

clue.text: Large orderly

explanation.definitionFit: A tidy sum is a large one, and a neat room is orderly.

clue.text: Drop in here to see promoter

indicators.note: in places the drop word inside the here word

parts.note: being here means being present
to sag is to droop or drop

explanation.surface: Come by this place to meet the event organiser.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drop in' reads as a phrase meaning visit, but the two words do separate jobs. 'to see' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A press agent publicises a client to the media, working as a promoter.

clue.text: Built for the water, attention-seeker in Ganges, swimming

indicators.note: in puts the attention cry inside the river name
swimming suggests the letters moving about freely, so they are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
oi is a shout used to get someone's attention

explanation.surface: A craft made for water, with someone showing off in the Ganges as he bathes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is the container signal and 'swimming' the anagram signal; OI is a cry to get someone's attention.
explanation.definitionFit: A seagoing vessel is designed and fit for voyages on the open sea.

clue.text: Money generated in US state that's after business

indicators.note: the state abbreviation is placed after the business abbreviation

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a business
ME is the postal abbreviation for Maine

explanation.surface: Earnings made in an American state that follow from a commercial venture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's after' places the state abbreviation behind the business one; Maine's postal code is used.
explanation.definitionFit: Income is the money earned or brought in over a period.

clue.text: Warehouse had many drinks returned

indicators.note: returned asks for the drinking word to be turned back to front

parts.note: to tope is to drink heavily, so had many drinks is toped

explanation.surface: A storehouse where someone downed a lot of drinks and came back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' reverses TOPED.
explanation.definitionFit: A depot is a place for storing goods, a warehouse or store.

clue.text: Large vessel — good grief, one swallowed by fish!

indicators.note: being swallowed means going inside, so these letters sit within the fish

parts.note: a carp is a freshwater fish
gosh is an exclamation of surprise like good grief
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Astonishment at a big boat, and at a fish gulping something down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swallowed by' is the container signal; the exclamation and the numeral go inside the fish together.
explanation.definitionFit: A cargo ship is a big freight-carrying vessel.

clue.text: Red Guard about to arrest new student

indicators.note: arresting someone means holding them, so the new letter is held inside
about suggests turning things around, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Maoist militia member is about to detain a fresh student.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges RED GUARD, and 'to arrest' holds N inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An undergrad is a university student still studying for a first degree.

clue.text: Pack of cards with ace in red

indicators.note: in places the ace letter inside the radical's word

parts.note: Trot is short for Trotskyist, a left-wing radical or red
A is the abbreviation for ace on playing cards

explanation.surface: A deck containing an ace among the red cards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'red' is not a colour here: TROT, short for Trotskyist, is a common crossword word for a left-winger.
explanation.definitionFit: A tarot is a special deck used in fortune-telling and some card games.

clue.text: What finds body tissue amid uprising?

definitions.text: What finds body tissue amid uprising?

indicators.note: amid places the tissue word in the middle of the uprising word

parts.note: a riot is a violent uprising
flesh is the soft tissue of the body

explanation.surface: Something that strikes a person in the middle of a riot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'amid' is the container signal, and the whole clue also describes a bullet hitting someone in a revolt.
explanation.definitionFit: A shot from a rifle strikes flesh, which is what happens in an armed uprising.

clue.text: Kind setter, say, uplifted

indicators.note: in a down clue lifting up means reading the pieces from bottom to top

parts.note: the sun sets each evening, so it is a setter
eg means for example, as does say

explanation.surface: The crossword compiler, being good-natured, is raised in spirits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setter' looks like the compiler but is the sun. 'uplifted' reverses SUN EG.
explanation.definitionFit: A genus is a category or class, a kind of thing in biology and elsewhere.

clue.text: Servers of drinks have some fish after a little time

indicators.note: the eating and fish pieces come after the time letter

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time
to have dinner is to eat it
rays are flat fish

explanation.surface: Waiters bringing drinks eat some fish once a short while has passed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' puts the eating and fish pieces behind the time letter; 'a little time' is the usual single-letter abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Trays for tea are things on which drinks are served and carried.

clue.text: Judge river superior to stream, ultimately

indicators.note: in a down clue being superior means sitting above, so the river comes first

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain

indicators.note: ultimately picks the final letter of the word stream

explanation.surface: Rate a river as better than a mere brook in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ultimately' takes M from stream and 'superior to' sets DEE above it.
explanation.definitionFit: To deem is to consider or judge something to be so.

clue.text: Stimulating leaf, good drug to have for a star

parts.note: betel leaves are chewed as a mild stimulant
E is slang for the drug ecstasy
to have or employ something is to use it

explanation.surface: A stimulating leaf and a good drug are taken to become a celebrity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' and 'for' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Betelgeuse is a red giant star in the constellation Orion.

clue.text: Difficult to cross river channel

indicators.note: the difficult word crosses the river letter, holding it inside

parts.note: tough means difficult

explanation.surface: It is hard to get across the river's waterway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to cross' puts R inside TOUGH.
explanation.definitionFit: A trough is a long narrow channel or depression, such as a gutter.

clue.text: In every other part of nature, God is OK

indicators.note: In places the god and is inside the alternate letters
every other part means taking alternate letters of the word nature

parts.note: Thor is the Norse god of thunder
taken as written

explanation.surface: Throughout nature, divinity is fine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'every other part of' takes the second, fourth and sixth letters of nature, and 'In' places the Norse god plus 'is' inside them.
explanation.definitionFit: To okay something is to approve or sanction it, the verb sense.

clue.text: Force of gravity in dreadful lament

indicators.note: in places the gravity letter inside the dreadful word

parts.note: dire means dreadful
g is the symbol for acceleration due to gravity

explanation.surface: The weight of seriousness in a terrible song of mourning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts G inside DIRE.
explanation.definitionFit: A dirge is a mournful song or lament for the dead.

clue.text: Taking king into Agincourt, customised vehicle

indicators.note: into places the king letter within the battle name
customised means altered, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
R stands for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: Bringing a monarch to the famous battle in a modified car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' puts R in AGINCOURT and 'customised' shuffles the result. Agincourt was Henry V's 1415 victory. 'Taking' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A touring car is a type of vehicle, an open car designed for long journeys or a racing class.

clue.text: Child dropped off book

parts.note: a kid is a child
to drop off is to doze, so dropped off means napped

explanation.surface: A youngster was left at a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dropped off' suggests a child delivered somewhere, but here it means fell asleep.
explanation.definitionFit: Kidnapped is the 1886 adventure novel by Robert Louis Stevenson.

clue.text: Immediately in trouble

definitions.meaning: at once, right there and then
in a difficult position, put under pressure

explanation.definitionFit: Acting at once means doing it there and then, and being put under pressure is being in an awkward fix.

clue.text: Versatile actor in a protective garment

indicators.note: versatile means able to turn to many things, so these letters change their order

explanation.surface: An adaptable performer in a coat that keeps him dry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Versatile' rearranges ACTOR IN A.
explanation.definitionFit: A raincoat is a garment worn to protect against wet weather.

clue.text: Sailor hat

definitions.meaning: someone who goes out in a boat
a stiff straw hat with a flat crown

explanation.definitionFit: A person who goes boating sails, and the flat straw hat is named after such boating.

clue.text: Hindu ascetic as melancholy getting brief hug

parts.note: melancholy means sad

indicators.note: a brief word is cut short, so the last letter of hug is dropped

explanation.surface: A holy man, feeling down, gets a quick embrace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brief' drops the G of HUG. 'as' and 'getting' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A sadhu is a Hindu holy man who has renounced worldly life.

clue.text: Different article, gilt-edged?

indicators.note: edged means the gold letters form a border around the article

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: Is a piece with gilded edges something else?
explanation.walkthrough: 'edged' is the container signal; gold in heraldry is the solver's key to 'gilt'.
explanation.definitionFit: Other means different or distinct from the one already mentioned.

clue.text: Raised something that may have risen in speech

indicators.note: in speech signals the word is said out loud

parts.note: bread dough rises when it proves

explanation.surface: Raised: some leavened item, so to say.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in speech' gives the homophone of BREAD.
explanation.definitionFit: To be bred is to be brought up or reared, as in born and raised.
